posts.content_md:
Holographic Productions 

 features 

 The Dragon Hologram

Holographic Productions launches holographic product line using Ultimate emulsions.

Holographic Productions is a new company located in Ontario, Canada. 

The Dragon Hologram is the first stunning hologram that is now being marketed through specialty shops and Internet web sites. 

Holographer Larry Lieberman says, 

"the Ultimate emulsion invented by Yves Gentet is the solution that holographers needed to make the best possible holograms. We well see a new generation of holograms. I have been making holograms for 35 years and The Dragon Hologram is the best hologram I have ever made. It is bright, clean and crisp. The image seems to float on a clear piece of glass.

The Ultimate takes some finesse to perfect but it is by far can make the best holograms yet."
